about_the_game:
100% Orange Juice - Suguri & Hime Winter Costume DLC contains new skins with an all-new look for the popular duo from SUGURI series - Suguri and Hime. The costumes are themed after the pair's appearance in Sora.

If user does not have Suguri and Hime unlocked in 100% Orange Juice, DLC grants direct access to them.

The new costumes are designed by Orange Juice’s original staff for the game’s Steam version, with character artwork by Hono.
